subject: Initiate collaboration plan & 8-week evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@zenwell.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate collaboration plan & 8-week evaluation timeline

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for the demo earlier this week. Per our conversation I wanted to start the collaboration plan so we have clear owners, milestones, and a proposed close window. My goal is to make the evaluation run predictably and surface any blocker early so your team can evaluate on schedule.

High-level proposal (8-week evaluation):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, stakeholder alignment, access + test data plan
- Week 1–3: POC setup, performance checks, basic integration
- Week 4–6: workload-focused eval, quality checks, quantization/latency tuning
- Week 7–8: final validation, procurement redlines, executive sign-off

As next steps I suggest a 45-minute kickoff call next week to confirm owners and accept this timeline. I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that shows suggested owners and deliverables — feel free to edit and share. Also linking a short MAP template and our HubSpot deal for reference.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft.xlsx (MAP template, editable)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cRedwood-zenwell-MAP-draft

Quick asks:
1) Can you confirm the internal champion for integration work (API keys, test dataset)?
2) Who owns procurement/legal on your side (for contract timing)?
3) Available times for a kickoff (I proposed two below).

Proposed kickoff slots (PST):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Jul 14, 15:00–15:45

Neha (cc) will own the health checks and runbook items from our side. Marissa is looped in for any contract/discount discussions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@zenwell.io>

Subject: Re: Initiate collaboration plan & 8-week evaluation timeline

Aditya —

Thanks for drafting this. The timeline looks reasonable to me; the champion for the integration work will be Priya Shah (she’s cc’d). Procurement is handled by our vendor ops team (I’ll introduce the main contact during kickoff). A few clarifying points:

- We’ll want to include a short security questionnaire run early (SOC 2 artifacts + data handling). I attached our standard vendor checklist.
- For the POC we can provide a synthetic dataset and one anonymized sample; Priya will confirm exact format.
- Kickoff: Wed Jul 14 at 15:00 PST works best for the team.

Thanks — I’ll review the MAP and send any edits by EOD Monday.

—Sanjay

- Provide a trimmed MAP with suggested test cases and success criteria.
- Setup a short Slack channel for day-to-day POC coordination (I’ll send the invite to Priya and your vendor ops contact after kickoff).

Thanks — see you on the 14th.

Aditya

Hi all —

Looping in deliverables and an initial stakeholder roster from our side so Priya and Sanjay know who will be on the breakout calls:

- Marissa Cole — Sales manager (escalations / pricing)
- Technical PD: Marcus Lin (will join the technical breakout) — I’ll share Marcus’ calendar availability after kickoff.

From our checklist, we’ll need:

I’ll attach the MAP we’ll use during the kickoff (redwood_map_draft.xlsx) and a short slide with the evaluation success criteria. If either of you want a pre-kickoff sync (15m) to walk the MAP before Wed, I’m available Tue Jul 13, 11:00–11:30 PST.
